interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to three (one in each direction plus a center turn lane) to slow traffic and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with advanced warning signs or a pedestrian-actuated signal.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with signage to provide a designated and visible crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked, high-visibility crosswalks with appropriate signage to designate legal crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting along the sidewalk to improve visibility and personal security during dark hours.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is present, install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to slow turning vehicles and shorten the conflict zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage if there is pedestrian demand for park access.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add a marked bike lane to provide further separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles while supporting active transportation.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk and RRFB
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island or Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) to provide a safe crossing point to the park.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or physical buffers to narrow travel lanes and reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for protected bike lanes to narrow travel lanes and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked high-visibility crosswalk with curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility 'continental' markings and appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the grass buffer would provide vertical enclosure, narrowing the driver's field of vision and naturally slowing traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If there is pedestrian demand for the sports field, a marked mid-block crossing with a refuge island should be considered to provide safe passage.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk and Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Continuity and Curb Definition
interventions.description: Install a continuous sidewalk with a defined curb and clear driveway aprons to separate the walkway from the private parking area.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to reduce vehicle speeds along this straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage to provide a safe path to the park.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds along the park frontage.
